profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Abbott
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the medical device & health care industry. Skilled in C++, CI/CD, Agile practices, Usability Engineering, 3D graphics and visualization, and Human Computer Interaction. Strong engineering professional with a PhD focused in Mechanical Engineering & Human Computer Interaction from Iowa State University.

Furthering my research on developing a framework analysis and visualization of digital medical image data to automatically segment tumors from CT/MRI data and developing an interactive visualization software.

positions.title: Post Doctoral Research Associate
positions.description: Skills: Engineering Management · Software Design · Emerging Technologies · JavaScript · Medical Technology · Software Development · Collaborative Environment

positions.title: Project Manager / Researcher / Lead Developer
positions.description:
Team of 6, ~50k lines of code
Leading a team to develop a desktop and immersive software framework for visualization and analysis of
medical image data in 3D. Researching new techniques for tumor segmentation and image processing; and
developing usable interfaces for surgical planning, auscultation training, and diagnosis. Designing and
conducting studies on the effectiveness of 2D vs 3D, and mono vision vs stereo vision for anatomy identification.

- Main libraries: VTK, Coin3D, SIMVoleon, VRJuggler, DCMTK, gdcm, Qt, Boost, OpenGL
- Other skills: Fuzzy Logic, Probabilistic Algorithms, DICOM, Human Factors, Design Usability, Proposal Writing
- Deployment platforms: Mac OS X, Windows

positions.title: Project Manager / Researcher / Developer
positions.description:
Team of 15, ~100k lines of code
Research and management of a $12M project funded by the Air Force Office of Scientific Research to develop
new technology for the monitoring and control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in a virtual environment.
Combined interfaces such as virtual reality, touchable screens, and semi-autonomous rovers for a multi-modal
battlespace simulation. Also developed an interactive 3D UAV path planner using Particle Swarm Optimization
(PSO) and performed study on the effectiveness of 3D environments for UAV path planning.

- Main libraries: OpenSceneGraph (OSG), VRJuggler, OpenDIS, Boost, OpenGL
- Other skills: Particle Swarm Optimization, Path Planning, Clustered Networking, Multi-Threading
- Deployment platforms: Mac OS X, Linux RHEL5
